device_entry.name: Keithley 2400 / Lake Shore 350 联合实验控制组件
device_entry.name_en: Keithley 2400 / Lake Shore 350 Experiment Control Component
tags: 环境控制与稳定性测试
device_entry.description: 一个非物理软件组件，用于协调 Keithley 2400 源表与 Lake Shore 350 温控器的实验流程。它负责仪器连接、参数配置、温度读取、加热器量程与温度设定值设置、温度斜坡控制、电学测量读取，以及实验图形界面的创建、样式、日志和状态管理。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical software component that coordinates experiments involving a Keithley 2400 source meter and a Lake Shore 350 temperature controller. It handles instrument connection, configuration, temperature readback, heater-range and setpoint control, temperature ramping, electrical measurement readout, and GUI creation, styling, logging, and UI state management.
